# AI chat tool bar

Figma: standalone symbol `AI chat tool bar`, node `1997:40096` (page Components, `1:28`).
Not a variant set. Measured as an instance inside [AI chat bubble](AiMessage.md).

The feedback row under an assistant reply: copy, unhelpful, save, show sources.

## Markup

```html
<div class="v27-ai-toolbar">
  <button type="button" class="v27-ai-toolbar__action" aria-label="Copy">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"></svg>
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="v27-ai-toolbar__action" aria-label="Unhelpful">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"></svg>
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="v27-ai-toolbar__action" aria-label="Save">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"></svg>
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="v27-ai-toolbar__action" aria-label="Show sources">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"></svg>
  </button>
</div>
```

Every control is icon-only, so every one needs an `aria-label`. Figma's four glyphs are
clone/copy, thumbs-down, star and eye; the labels above are what those glyphs mean in
context, not translations of the icon names.

## Classes

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.v27-ai-toolbar` | the row |
| `.v27-ai-toolbar__action` | one 24px action |

## Values

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| gap | `--v27-spacing-s` (8px) |
| action | `--v27-size-m` (24px) |
| colour | `Foreground/Secondary` |

Figma defines **no hover, focus or pressed state** for these controls, and no toggled state
for the ones that are clearly toggles - thumbs-down and star. None is invented here, so a
consumer must supply the feedback for "this is now saved". That is a real gap for a control
whose entire purpose is to be toggled.

## All classes in this component

`.v27-ai-toolbar`, `.v27-ai-toolbar__action`
